_about: Standard parts likely for echo's real connections. Units mm, N, kN, g as named. Data from makers' catalogues, standards extracts and engineering reference tables; no shopping links and no retailer figures. null = no citable value found, never an estimate. 'read_via' is 'document' when the table itself was read, 'search_excerpt' when only a search excerpt of the page could be read (recheck before relying on it).

_sources.iso_7380: ISO 7380-1:2011 extract (dk max, range M3 and up); k and s from fastenerdata.co.uk ISO 7380 data table. ISO 7380-1:2022 changed dw,min; check the current edition
_sources.jc_7089: jcfasteners.com ISO 7089 washer data sheet B6iD02 (M2-M5 ranges); westfieldfasteners.co.uk/Standards ISO 7089 data sheet (nominals)
_sources.optimas: optimas.com/technical-resources/tapping-sizes (ISO metric coarse tapping and clearance table)
_sources.wuerth: wuerth.de/web/media/downloads/pdf/diniso/Zusammenfassung_ISO_898-1_und_3506-1.pdf: p3 ISO 898-1 loads, p6 ISO 3506-1 loads
_sources.skf: skf.com product pages, deep groove ball bearings, productid-<designation>
_sources.iko: IKO catalogue CAT-57166 Crossed Roller Bearings, June 2008: Super Slim table p6 (file page), features table p2
_sources.ruthex: ruthex.de/en/pages/cad-daten; part designations give insert length
_sources.3dpeople: 3D People threaded inserts guide (felix-manley-n4jm.squarespace.com, 2023-06-12), PA12 design table
_sources.bossard: Bossard technical sheet F.044, file f-039-en.pdf on media.bossard.com
_sources.helicoil: The Manual of Fastening (scribd copy), citing DIN 8140

iso7380_button_head.note: Reduced loadability by the standard's own title. ISO 7380-1 covers M3 and up.

iso10642_countersunk.note: Reduced loadability by the standard's own title. The table starts at M3.

washers_iso7089.note: One other standards page gives M5 inner max 5.48.

holes.note: Clearance series as in ISO 273 (close/fine, medium, free/coarse). The actuator STEP bores equal these tap drills.

dowel_pins_iso8734_m6.note: Hardened, tolerance m6. Lengths not captured: null. The RS04 hub carries its own 6 mm pins; RS00, RS02, RS03 and RS06 hubs have pin holes for 3 or 4 mm.

tappex_hole_dia_range.note: Through-hole types. Hole size depends on the insert family: use the table for the insert chosen.

ruthex_length.note: Hole diameter by size not found on a maker page; take it from the CAD data.

pa12_design_values.pull_strength_note: Average from the same vendor; material and test conditions not stated in what could be read. Not a PA12 design allowable.

heat_set_inserts.unread_datasheets: PEM SI data (pemnet.com sidata.pdf), Spirol design guide, Kerb-Konus ds.30 and Boellhoff AMTEC hold full tables, but they could not be read here. Read them before fixing an insert family.

thin_section_bearings.fit_rule: bore 25-45, width up to 8, for the knee and elbow idlers

deep_groove_618.note: SKF pages render empty to the fetch tool, so these come from excerpts. 61809 was converted from 1214 lbf, 899 lbf, 0.084 lb. Non-SKF listings differ for 61806 and 61809 (for example 6.63 kN for 61809). Confirm on the SKF product page. Open 61808 was not found.

just_outside_the_fit_rule.CRBH 3010 A and 4010 A: width 10: too wide; ratings not captured

crossed_roller_iko.note: Catalogue dated 2008; check the current IKO range. Roller bearings take radial, axial and moment load in a single bearing. The 25-45 bore, 8 wide slot has no entry here: the choice is 5 wide CRBT or another maker.

aluminium.rule: 2.0 x d minimum for a steel screw tapped directly into aluminium
aluminium.basis: Project rule set at the top of the cited range, not a standard's statement. Bossard F.044: about 1.4 to 2.0 x d for cast aluminium, by screw class and thread type. Manual of Fastening: 2 x d in aluminium without an insert, 1.5 x d with one.
aluminium.check: Run the Bossard thread engagement calculator for the alloy chosen. Full preload of a 12.9 screw is not available if the actuator's own thread is shallower than this: see spec/actuator_interfaces.json.

pa12.basis: No citable engagement rule found for screws tapped directly into PA12. Use heat-set inserts, with the hole and depth values above, and pull-test a coupon.

class_12_9_steel_iso898_1.note: The table starts at M3. M2 and M2.5 need another source.

stainless_iso3506_1.note: No stainless screw is a 12.9 equivalent. The nearest are below. Values are force at 0.2 % proof (Fpf) and minimum breaking load (Fmf). No M2 or M2.5 row in this table.
